recipes.name: Beef Broth (RtP)
recipes.description: Kaldu daging sapi dengan perbandingan 1:1 (1kg tulang dan 1 kg air).

prep.text: with room temp. water (1-2 min/kg). Pat dry or air dry to prevent uneven browning.
prep.title: Rinse

finish.title: Strain
finish.text: using fine strainer or cheesecloth
Brix 7.0, Salt level 0.17

finish.text: Immediately used?

options.label: Immediate use
options.text: Scoop the beef broth and skim the beef tallow. Keep broth ≥ 60°C.

options.label: Store
options.text: Immediately cool down until 21°C within 2 hr using ice bath, to 5°C within next 4 hr in the freezer. Label production date. Thaw in fridge before use.

finish.title: Beef tallow
finish.text: After storing the broth in the fridge, a golden layer will be formed on top. Scrape this and store as Beef Tallow, useful later. When used immediately, skim the fat layer and store it.

procedures.title: Roasting
procedures.instructions: 200°C, 30-40 min, golden brown. Aluminum foil underneath. Turn once halfway.
procedures.tools: Could set to highest temp. with shorter time

procedures.title: Parboil
procedures.instructions: Start boiling. Heat to 100°C, then 3-5 min, just enough water. Stir occationally. Dump water.

procedures.title: Rinse
procedures.instructions: 40-50°C high-pressure water. Only clean surface briefly.

procedures.title: Simmer
procedures.instructions: 24 hrs. Start cold, heat to below simmering (92 C). Skim in first 30-60 mins. Slightly open the lid.
procedures.tools: Clean stockpot, filtered water. Use induction or slow cooker if left alone.

notes.title: Shimmering durations
notes.body: Meaty flavor extraction and gelatin extraction has different timetable.

notes.title: Narrow pot
notes.body: Narrow pot helps for small-scale production

notes.title: Reverse Osmosis Water
notes.body: Is the best quality water for this kind of food. Carbon filter is also fine.

notes.title: Oil on roasting
notes.body: Unnecessary, burdening cost and potentially leaving greasy-film on the broth.

notes.title: Roasting liquids
notes.body: Pour on heatproof cup and let it sit for 2-3 mins. Strain golden top layer as a beef tallow. Discard black residue. Add darker juice to the broth. Deglaze brown bits (using the water for broth, do not add more) and add to broth (not when parboiling).

notes.title: Simmer temperature
notes.body: Should not see steam breaking the surface. Tony bubbles. Never rolling boil. Do not add too much water (max 12%).

recipes.name: Proposal Bumbu Bacem Induk
recipes.description: Master bacem for every sate. Sweet-gurih Klaten profile, kept alive like a Chinese lu shui master stock: reused, topped up, boiled daily.

prep.title: Peel
prep.text: shallots and garlic. Shave gula jawa. Dissolve tamarind in 100 ml of the water, strain out seeds.

finish.title: Strain
finish.text: out galangal and salam if storing more than 1 day. Leave the paste in; it is part of the coating.

finish.title: QC
finish.text: Record Brix and salt % of the first batch as your house standard. Match every later batch and top-up to it.

ingredients.name: Used master bacem
ingredients.description: Best after 2-3 uses: richer from the meat juices

ingredients.name: Margarine
ingredients.description: Classic Javanese sate oles. Or chicken fat

procedures.title: Reduce
procedures.instructions: Simmer until reduced by half and it coats a spoon, 10-12 min.
procedures.tools: Yakitori tare method

procedures.title: Mount
procedures.instructions: Off heat, whisk in margarine. Keep warm by the grill; dip or brush in the last minute of grilling only.

finish.text: Start of each day?

options.label: Revive
options.text: Bring to a full boil 5 min, skim. Top up with fresh half batch when the level drops by a third.

options.label: Discard
options.text: Throw it out and start a fresh batch. Never top up a spoiled stock.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: Cool fast, chill at 4°C or below. Full refresh every 7 days.

ingredients.name: Cooking oil
ingredients.description: Or rendered chicken fat from Proposal Sate Kulit Ayam

ingredients.name: Coconut water
ingredients.description: Air kelapa tua, often free or cheap from santan sellers

procedures.title: Toast
procedures.instructions: Dry pan, low-medium heat until fragrant and a shade darker, 2-3 min.

procedures.title: Blend
procedures.instructions: Blend to a smooth paste with a splash of the oil.

procedures.title: Fry paste
procedures.instructions: Fry paste in the oil, medium heat, stirring, until it stops smelling raw and turns light brown, 6-8 min.
procedures.tools: Browning the paste first builds the deep, roasted note

procedures.title: Bloom
procedures.instructions: Add galangal and salam, stir 1 min.

procedures.title: Simmer
procedures.instructions:
Add the rest. Bring to a boil, then simmer gently 20 min, uncovered.

Taste: clearly sweet first, then salty-gurih, slight sour finish.

notes.title: Why one master bacem
notes.body: One pot seasons every sate, so taste is consistent and cost per skewer drops. Each batch of meat cooked in it leaves gelatin and savoury juices behind, like a Chinese master stock (lu shui): the bacem gets better with use.

notes.title: Klaten taste
notes.body: Klaten and Solo eat sweet-forward: gula jawa and kecap first, gurih second, heat on the side. Serve sambal kecap or rawit separately rather than making the bacem spicy.

notes.title: Coconut water
notes.body: Traditional bacem liquid. Its sugars help the dark, glossy colour; replace with water plus 50 g extra gula jawa if unavailable.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 30.000 per 2 L batch (assumed Klaten market prices, verify locally). Because it is reused, each sate batch only absorbs a small share.

recipes.name: Proposal Sate Ati Ampela
recipes.description: Tender gizzard, creamy liver. Each part cooked for its own time, then bacem-soaked overnight and grilled with tare.

prep.title: Soak
prep.text: bamboo skewers in water 30 min so they don't burn.

finish.text: Selling today?

options.label: Grill to order
options.text: Keep skewered sate chilled; grill per order or in small batches every 30 min.

options.label: Store
options.text: Keep unskewered in the bacem, 4°C, up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: Chicken liver
ingredients.description: Ati ayam. Cut into 20 pieces, keep lobes whole if small

procedures.title: Soak
procedures.instructions: Soak livers in cold brine 20 min to draw out blood, which turns bitter when cooked. Drain.

procedures.title: Trim & Score
procedures.instructions: Peel off the yellow lining and thick silverskin. Halve; score each piece in a cross-hatch, 2 mm deep.
procedures.tools: Scoring = yakitori sunagimo cut: faster cooking, more bacem grip

procedures.title: Blanch
procedures.instructions: Start in boiling water with ginger, 3 min. Drain, discard water, rinse.
procedures.tools: Chinese chao shui: removes scum and offal smell

procedures.title: Simmer gizzards
procedures.instructions: Gizzards into bacem. Gentle simmer, lid ajar, until a skewer slides in easily, 40-45 min.
procedures.tools: Pressure cooker: 15 min

procedures.title: Steep livers
procedures.instructions: Heat off. Add livers to the hot bacem, cover, steep 10 min. Inside should be just set, pale pink-brown, not grey.
procedures.tools: Never boil liver: it turns grainy and bitter

procedures.title: Rest
procedures.instructions: Cool in the bacem, chill overnight so the colour and flavour go all the way through.

procedures.title: Skewer
procedures.instructions: Per skewer: ampela, ati, ampela.

procedures.title: Grill
procedures.instructions: Medium-hot charcoal, 1 min per side. Dip in tare, grill 30 secs more per side until glossy and lightly charred.

notes.title: Two parts, two timings
notes.body: Gizzard is tough muscle and needs 40+ min; liver is done in minutes. Cooking them together is why most sate ati ampela has hard gizzard or chalky liver.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 1.900 per skewer (ati ampela ~Rp 30.000/kg assumed). Typical price at soto stalls Rp 4.000-5.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Sate Telur Uritan
recipes.description: Unlaid chicken eggs poached gently so they stay whole and creamy, then soaked like Japanese ajitama in master bacem.

prep.title: Sort
prep.text: uritan by size. Pull off the stringy oviduct strands; leave any small attached membrane.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: In the bacem, 4°C, up to 2 days. Skewer the day of sale.

ingredients.name: Uritan
ingredients.description: Telur muda ayam. About 4-5 per skewer, depending on size

ingredients.name: Bamboo skewers
ingredients.description: Thin skewers split the yolks less

procedures.title: Heat
procedures.instructions: Bring salted water to 85°C: small bubbles on the bottom, surface barely moving.

procedures.title: Poach
procedures.instructions: Slide uritan in. Hold 85°C for 5 min until set and opaque. Do not boil: bubbles burst the yolks.
procedures.tools: Salted water firms the outer skin faster

procedures.title: Shock
procedures.instructions: Lift into ice water 5 min to firm. Drain.

procedures.title: Steep
procedures.instructions: Warm bacem to 80°C, heat off, add uritan, steep 15 min. Cool and soak at least 4 hr, or overnight.
procedures.tools: Ajitama principle: flavour goes in by soaking, not by boiling

procedures.title: Skewer
procedures.instructions: 4-5 per skewer through the centre, gently.

procedures.title: Glaze
procedures.instructions: Brush with tare, warm on a mesh over medium coals 1 min per side. Or serve as bacem without grilling.

notes.title: Freshness
notes.body: Buy uritan the same morning; they spoil faster than eggs. Smell should be clean, yolks bright orange and taut.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 1.900 per skewer (uritan ~Rp 60.000/kg assumed). Typical price Rp 4.000-5.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Sate Paru Bacem Garing
recipes.description: Beef lung boiled tender, pressed flat for clean slices, bacem-braised, then fried for crisp edges. The beef option.

prep.title: Rinse
prep.text: lung under running water. Cut into fist-size pieces; pierce all over with a knife so trapped air escapes.

finish.text: Selling today?

options.label: Fry in small batches
options.text: Fry every 1-2 hr so they stay crisp on display.

options.label: Store
options.text: Keep braised, unfried slices at 4°C up to 3 days, or freeze up to 1 month.

ingredients.name: Beef lung
ingredients.description: Paru sapi. About 600 g after boiling

procedures.title: Blanch
procedures.instructions: Boil 5 min, discard water and scum.

procedures.title: Boil
procedures.instructions: Fresh water with aromatics and salt. Simmer until a knife goes in with no bounce, 60-75 min. Weigh down so pieces stay under.

procedures.title: Press
procedures.instructions: While warm, lay on a tray, cover with a second tray and 3-5 kg weight. Chill 2 hr.
procedures.tools: Chinese pressed-meat method: dense, even slices that don't crumble

procedures.title: Slice
procedures.instructions: 1 cm thick, about 3 x 4 cm.

procedures.title: Bacem
procedures.instructions: Simmer in bacem 20 min, turning, until dark. Drain on a rack; air-dry 30 min (fan helps).
procedures.tools: Dry surface = crisp, less oil spatter

procedures.title: Fry
procedures.instructions: 170°C until edges are crisp and dark, 2-3 min. Drain.
procedures.tools: Sugar in the bacem burns above 175°C

procedures.title: Skewer & Glaze
procedures.instructions: 3 slices per skewer. Brush with tare; optional 30 secs on the grill.

notes.title: Shared prep
notes.body: If you already boil paru for soto toppings, boil one big batch and split it.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 3.400 per skewer (paru sapi ~Rp 70.000/kg assumed, ~40% boil loss). Price Rp 6.000-7.000; it is the premium sate.

recipes.name: Proposal Sate Telur Puyuh
recipes.description: Quail eggs that peel clean in bulk, soaked overnight in master bacem like Korean mayak gyeran, then glazed.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: In the bacem, 4°C, up to 4 days.

procedures.title: Boil
procedures.instructions: Rolling boil with vinegar.

procedures.title: Cook
procedures.instructions: Lower eggs into boiling water (hot start). 4 min.
procedures.tools: Hot start peels far easier than cold start

procedures.title: Shock & Crack
procedures.instructions: Ice water 5 min. Drain, put in a lidded box with a little water, shake hard 20 secs to crack all shells. Peel under water.

procedures.title: Simmer
procedures.instructions: Simmer peeled eggs in bacem 10 min, stirring, for even colour.

procedures.title: Soak
procedures.instructions: Cool in the bacem; chill overnight.
procedures.tools: Mayak gyeran principle: long soak, deep colour all the way to the yolk

procedures.title: Skewer
procedures.instructions: 4 eggs per skewer.

procedures.title: Glaze
procedures.instructions: Optional: brush with tare, grill 30 secs per side.

notes.title: Why cook first, soak after
notes.body: Boiling eggs long in sugary bacem makes whites rubbery. Short simmer plus long cold soak gives a tender white and a deep colour.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 1.700 per skewer (quail eggs ~Rp 33.000/kg assumed). Typical price Rp 3.000-4.000. The bestseller at most soto stalls.

recipes.name: Proposal Sate Usus Gulung
recipes.description: Chicken intestine cleaned until odour-free, wound tight on skewers, bacem-braised, then grilled or fried crisp.

finish.text: Which finish?

options.label: Sate bakar
options.text: Brush with Proposal Tare Bacem, grill over medium coals 1-2 min per side until edges char.

options.label: Sate goreng
options.text: Air-dry 20 min, fry at 170°C 2 min until crisp. Holds crispness longer on display.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: Braised, unfinished skewers keep at 4°C up to 3 days. Grill or fry to order.

ingredients.name: Chicken intestine
ingredients.description: Usus ayam, about 25-30 g per skewer

procedures.title: Clean
procedures.instructions: Flush the inside with running water. Scrub with salt and tamarind 2 min until no longer slimy. Rinse well.
procedures.tools: Salt scrubs, acid cuts the smell

procedures.title: Blanch
procedures.instructions: Boil with ginger and salam 5 min. Discard water, rinse.
procedures.tools: Chinese chao shui

procedures.title: Wind
procedures.instructions: Wind tightly around each skewer, tucking the ends.
procedures.tools: Tight = cooks evenly, doesn't unravel

procedures.title: Bacem
procedures.instructions: Lay skewers in bacem, simmer 30 min, turning once. Drain on a rack.

notes.title: Smell is the deal-breaker
notes.body: Clean, acid scrub and blanch-and-discard are not optional. Customers forgive a tough usus, never a smelly one.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 800 per skewer (usus ~Rp 15.000/kg assumed). Price Rp 2.500-3.000: the highest margin item.

recipes.name: Proposal Sate Kulit Ayam
recipes.description: Yakitori kawa method: skin pre-rendered in diluted bacem, packed tight on skewers, grilled slow until crisp. The fat it gives off is a free by-product.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: Skewered, pre-simmered skin keeps 3 days at 4°C. Strain the skimmed fat, chill, use for frying paste or drizzling on soto.

ingredients.name: Chicken skin
ingredients.description: Kulit ayam, neck and back skin is cheapest

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.description: Dilutes the bacem so sugar doesn't scorch

procedures.title: Trim
procedures.instructions: Scrape off loose fat blobs and any feather stubs. Cut into 4 cm wide strips.

procedures.title: Simmer
procedures.instructions: Simmer in bacem and water 15 min. Lift out, spread on a tray, chill 30 min until firm.
procedures.tools: Skim and keep the fat that floats: minyak ayam

procedures.title: Skewer
procedures.instructions: Weave strips back and forth (accordion), packed tightly, about 33 g per skewer.
procedures.tools: Tight packing = crisp outside, juicy inside

procedures.title: Grill
procedures.instructions: Medium coals, turn often, 8-10 min until fat has rendered and edges are crisp. Brush with tare in the last minute.
procedures.tools: Fat drips flare up: keep a coal-free zone

notes.title: Why simmer before grilling
notes.body: Raw skin on the grill flares and stays chewy inside. Simmering first starts the rendering and seasons it, so grilling only crisps.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 1.000 per skewer (kulit ~Rp 20.000/kg assumed). Price Rp 3.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Sate Babat Bacem
recipes.description: Beef tripe made tender in a pressure cooker, soaked in bacem and grilled. Beef option that can share the soto's tripe batch.

prep.title: Rinse
prep.text: cleaned tripe (babat handuk or babat putih) under running water; scrub with salt and rinse until it smells clean.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: In the bacem, 4°C, up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: Beef tripe
ingredients.description: Babat sapi, already cleaned. About 700 g after cooking

procedures.title: Blanch
procedures.instructions: Boil 5 min, discard water.

procedures.title: Pressure cook
procedures.instructions: With aromatics, salt and fresh water, 30 min from full pressure. Tender but still a little bite.
procedures.tools: Open pot: 2-2.5 hr simmer

procedures.title: Cut
procedures.instructions: Cool slightly, cut 2 x 4 cm pieces.

procedures.title: Bacem
procedures.instructions: Simmer in bacem 20 min. Cool and soak at least 2 hr, best overnight.

procedures.title: Skewer
procedures.instructions: Fold and pierce 3-4 pieces per skewer.

procedures.title: Grill
procedures.instructions: Hot coals 1 min per side, dip in tare, 30 secs more per side.

notes.title: Doneness
notes.body: Tripe goes from rubbery to tender, then to mushy. Check at 25 min the first time and note the time for your cooker.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 3.400 per skewer (babat ~Rp 75.000/kg assumed). Price Rp 6.000-7.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Sate Brutu
recipes.description: Chicken tail done like yakitori bonjiri: oil gland removed, bacem-simmered, grilled until the fat crisps.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: Braised, skewered brutu keeps 3 days at 4°C.

procedures.title: Trim gland
procedures.instructions: Cut out the yellow oil gland at the tip of each tail with a small V cut. Pluck feather stubs.
procedures.tools: The gland is the source of the 'prengus' smell. Never skip

procedures.title: Blanch
procedures.instructions: Boil with ginger 5 min. Discard water.

procedures.title: Bacem
procedures.instructions: Simmer in bacem 20 min. Drain.

procedures.title: Skewer
procedures.instructions: 2 tails per skewer, through the thickest part.

procedures.title: Grill
procedures.instructions: Medium coals, 6-8 min, turning, until fat renders and skin blisters. Tare in the last minute.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 1.600 per skewer (brutu ~Rp 25.000/kg assumed). Price Rp 4.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Sate Tsukune Ayam Tahu
recipes.description: Japanese tsukune made Klaten-style: chicken stretched with tofu, salt-kneaded for a bouncy bite, pre-poached, grilled with tare.

prep.title: Squeeze
prep.text: tofu in a cloth until dry and crumbly. Keep the chicken and tofu cold.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: Poached skewers keep 3 days at 4°C or 1 month frozen.

ingredients.name: Minced chicken
ingredients.description: Ayam giling: thigh with skin, or trimmings. Very cold

procedures.title: Knead
procedures.instructions: Knead chicken with salt and ice by hand or mixer 3-4 min until sticky and stringy.
procedures.tools: Salt draws out myosin: the springy bakso bite

procedures.title: Mix
procedures.instructions: Add the rest, mix just until even. Chill 15 min.

procedures.title: Shape
procedures.instructions: 40 g per skewer: press into a flat 10 cm log with wet hands.

procedures.title: Poach
procedures.instructions: Into water at a bare simmer (85-90°C), 6-8 min until firm and they float. Drain, cool.
procedures.tools: Pre-cooking = 2 min grill time at service

procedures.title: Grill
procedures.instructions: Medium-hot coals 1 min per side, dip in tare twice, grill until glossy and charred at the edges.

notes.title: Shared paste
notes.body: The same paste (without spring onion) fills Proposal Tahu Bakso Ayam. Make one batch for both.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 1.800 per skewer (ayam giling ~Rp 45.000/kg assumed; tofu replaces a third of the meat). Price Rp 4.000-5.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Tempe Goreng Garing
recipes.description: Thin tempe in a low-gluten rice-flour batter, double-fried Korean-style so it stays crisp on the display for hours.

finish.title: Serve
finish.text: with green cabe rawit. Do the second fry in small batches through the day.

ingredients.name: Ice-cold water
ingredients.description: Or ice-cold soda water for lacier crust

ingredients.name: Air kapur sirih
ingredients.description: Optional, clear limewater on top only. Classic gorengan crisp trick

procedures.title: Grind
procedures.instructions: Grind to a paste.

procedures.title: Slice
procedures.instructions: Slice 5 mm thick, 20 pieces.
procedures.tools: Thin = crisp through, cheaper per piece

procedures.title: Brine
procedures.instructions: Dissolve the paste in the water. Soak tempe 10 min. Drain.

procedures.title: Batter
procedures.instructions: Whisk flours, baking powder, a pinch of salt, ice water and kapur. Thin like cream. Mix only just before frying; keep cold.
procedures.tools: Cold + little wheat = little gluten = crisp, not bready

procedures.title: First fry
procedures.instructions: Dip, let excess drip off. Fry at 160°C, 3 min, pale gold. Drain on a rack.

procedures.title: Rest
procedures.instructions: At least 5 min (can hold up to 4 hr).
procedures.tools: Moisture moves to the surface

procedures.title: Second fry
procedures.instructions: 180°C, 60-90 secs until deep gold. Drain upright on a rack, not on paper.
procedures.tools: Korean double-fry: dries the crust so it stays crisp

notes.title: Oil life
notes.body: Fry tempe and vegetables before meat items, skim crumbs between batches, and filter the oil at the end of the day.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 600 per piece including oil (tempe ~Rp 12.000/kg assumed). Price Rp 2.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Bakwan Sayur Garing
recipes.description: Bakwan built like Japanese kakiage: vegetables dusted first, just enough cold batter to bind, fried thin and lacy.

finish.text: Display longer than 2 hr?

options.label: Serve
options.text: Drain upright on a rack; serve with green cabe rawit.

ingredients.name: Bean sprouts
ingredients.description: Tauge, tails off if time allows

procedures.title: Dust
procedures.instructions: Toss vegetables with the dusting flour until every strand is coated.
procedures.tools: Kakiage trick: dry flour first lets a thin batter grip

procedures.title: Grind
procedures.instructions: Grind to a fine paste.

procedures.title: Batter
procedures.instructions: Whisk paste, flours, baking powder and ice water briefly. Lumps are fine.

procedures.title: Bind
procedures.instructions: Fold batter into vegetables just before frying. Use only enough to bind; vegetables should show through.

procedures.title: Fry
procedures.instructions: Slide flat ladlefuls (about 50 g) into 170°C oil. Spread thin with a chopstick. 3-4 min, flip once, until golden and lacy.
procedures.tools: Thin and lacy = crisp and less batter per piece

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 750 per piece including oil. Price Rp 2.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Tahu Bakso Ayam
recipes.description: Tofu pockets filled with springy chicken paste, steamed ahead, fried to order. Same paste as Proposal Sate Tsukune.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: Steamed, unfried pieces keep 3 days at 4°C. Fry to order or in small batches.

finish.title: Serve
finish.text: with sambal kecap and rawit.

ingredients.name: Firm tofu
ingredients.description: Tahu putih or kuning, about 6 x 6 cm

procedures.title: Cut & Hollow
procedures.instructions: Halve each tofu into 2 triangles. Scoop a pocket from the cut side, 1 cm deep. Keep scraps.

procedures.title: Knead
procedures.instructions: Knead chicken, salt and ice 3-4 min until sticky.
procedures.tools: Salt + cold = bouncy bakso texture

procedures.title: Mix
procedures.instructions: Mix in 40 g tapioca, garlic, pepper, sugar, egg white and tofu scraps.

procedures.title: Stuff
procedures.instructions: Dab pockets with the reserved tapioca, then fill with paste (about 15 g), smoothing level with a wet spoon.
procedures.tools: Starch glues paste to tofu so it won't pop out

procedures.title: Steam
procedures.instructions: Steam over high heat 15 min until paste is firm. Cool on a rack.

procedures.title: Fry
procedures.instructions: 170°C, 2-3 min until golden and blistered.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 1.300 per piece (tahu ~Rp 1.000 each, ayam giling ~Rp 45.000/kg assumed). Price Rp 3.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Perkedel Kentang
recipes.description: The soto classic, built not to crumble: steamed and dried potato (Japanese korokke method), chilled before frying, egg-white coat.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: Shaped, uncoated perkedel keep 2 days at 4°C or 1 month frozen. Fry from chilled.

ingredients.name: Cooked beef trimmings
ingredients.description: Optional: shredded soto brisket offcuts. Free flavour

procedures.title: Steam
procedures.instructions: Steam until a fork goes in easily, 20 min.
procedures.tools: Steaming absorbs less water than boiling

procedures.title: Dry
procedures.instructions: Into a dry pan over low heat, shake 2 min until surface turns floury.
procedures.tools: Konafuki-imo: dry mash holds its shape

procedures.title: Mash
procedures.instructions: Mash while hot with the seasonings, celery and trimmings. Taste: well seasoned, slightly sweet.

procedures.title: Bind
procedures.instructions: Cool 10 min, then mix in the egg.

procedures.title: Shape & Chill
procedures.instructions: 45 g flat ovals, 1.5 cm thick. Chill on a tray at least 30 min.
procedures.tools: Cold perkedel doesn't break in the oil

procedures.title: Coat
procedures.instructions: Dip in egg white just before frying.

procedures.title: Fry
procedures.instructions: 170°C, 2-3 min. Don't touch for the first minute; flip once.

notes.title: Traditional flavour option
notes.body: Javanese perkedel fries the potato cubes before mashing: deeper flavour but uses more oil. Steaming is cheaper and gives a more stable shape.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 900 per piece (kentang ~Rp 15.000/kg assumed). Price Rp 2.500-3.000.

recipes.name: Proposal Usus Krispi
recipes.description: Crunchy fried chicken intestine: starch-heavy coating, Korean double-fry, sweet-salty Klaten seasoning dust. Sold by the cup.

finish.title: Storage
finish.text: Once cool, airtight jar up to 3 days. Re-fry 30 secs at 180°C if it softens.

procedures.title: Clean
procedures.instructions: Flush inside, scrub with salt and tamarind 2 min, rinse.

procedures.title: Blanch
procedures.instructions: Boil with ginger 5 min, discard water. Cut into 5 cm pieces.

procedures.title: Marinate
procedures.instructions: Grind garlic, coriander, turmeric and salt; rub in. 30 min.

procedures.title: Coat
procedures.instructions: Toss with egg white, then press into the mixed flours. Shake off excess; rest 5 min so the coating hydrates.
procedures.tools: Starch-heavy = glassy crunch

procedures.title: First fry
procedures.instructions: 160°C, 4 min, stirring to separate. Drain, rest 5 min.

procedures.title: Second fry
procedures.instructions: 180°C, 1-2 min until deep golden and dry-sounding.
procedures.tools: Korean double-fry

procedures.title: Season
procedures.instructions: Toss hot with the seasoning dust. 50 g per cup.

notes.title: Use the same supply
notes.body: Buy usus once for both Proposal Sate Usus Gulung and this; the thinner, broken pieces go here.

notes.title: Estimated cost
notes.body: About Rp 1.800 per 50 g cup including oil. Price Rp 5.000.
